title: Librarian
name: Nemien
description: A small, soft-spoken scholar returned to the Hamlet of her childhood, armed with a battered tome and an alarming quantity of secondhand knowledge. She would far rather sit by a hearth with a book than march into a dungeon, and says so, at length, before going anyway.
history: A daughter of the Hamlet, raised in a household that measured its women by the children they might bear and found her wanting, she escaped into scholarship and spent years studying in distant lands. Abroad she came upon a flawed and dangerous manuscript of local origin, and in reading it saw things she has told no one. She came home to a town far worse than she left it, carrying the book she will not let out of her hands.
summary: A timid, endlessly polite scholar of the Hamlet, returned from abroad with a dangerous book and the visions it gave her.

clothing.head: None
clothing.body: Purple scholar's robe over a high-collared shirt
clothing.accessories: Red sash, fingerless gloves, book-satchel at the hip

notes: Endlessly polite, with 'sir' and 'ma'am', apologizing before, during, and after everything
Grew up in the Hamlet and left only a few years ago; she knows its people, and they will recognize her
Vegetarian; refuses to eat anything that had a face
